mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary_media (id, diary_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{diaryId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, diary_id, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, created_at FROM diary_media WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
